name: tzdata2026e
purpose: The IANA time zone database in the .NET install (plan step N4.1, RFC 0015 section 8): the sources of the release by the SHA-256 of its tarball, compiled on the Linux host by zic into the TZif files of /usr/share/zoneinfo, which TimeZoneInfo reads as on Linux (TZDIR's default), with zone.tab, zone1970.tab and iso3166.tab beside them. The newest release when the step was made; a later one moves the pin.
